items.evidence: All three .tier cards share identical border, padding (18px), and flex layout with price in the same position within each card.
The 'Monotoggle' has 'Monthly' with class 'on' (blue background) and 'Annual' plain gray text — visually distinct active/inactive states.

All three CTA buttons and cards share identical blue styling with no highlighted or 'popular' tier; the Contact sales button is styled identically to the plan CTAs, so no single element carries unique emphasis.
.tier .price is 28px bold while the /mo span is 14px font-weight 400 — clearly subordinate.
The form sits below the tiers section with a simple input and button, not overlapping or outshining the plan cards.
DEFAULT array (Starter/Team/Enterprise) is only used via `Array.isArray(window.__DATA__) ? window.__DATA__ : DEFAULT`, a genuine fallback distinct from any injected data.
No annual price is ever rendered anywhere in the markup or script; only `${t.monthly}` is shown regardless of toggle state.

`document.getElementById("tiers").innerHTML = data.map(t => `

${t.name}

...`)` interpolates t.name directly into innerHTML rather than using textContent.
There is no element anywhere with `data-testid="billing-monthly"` — only `billing-toggle` exists on the Annual div.
The Annual toggle div has no click handler or script reference (`billing-toggle` is never read in JS), so prices never re-render and form persistence is untested/irrelevant.
All three .tier cards share identical border, border-radius, padding, and price div appears right after h2 in the same position in each card.
'Monthly' div has class 'on' with blue background/white text, 'Annual' div is plain gray text — visually distinguishable active state without reading labels.

All three CTA buttons (Choose Starter/Team/Enterprise) and the Contact sales button share identical blue background and padding — no single plan is visually emphasized over the others or over the form.
.price is font-size:28px bold, while the /mo span is font-size:14px font-weight:400 — price is clearly largest and period is subordinate.
Form with email input (data-testid=email) and Contact sales button sits below the tiers section, small and unobtrusive, not competing for first attention.
const data = Array.isArray(window.__DATA__) ? window.__DATA__ : DEFAULT — DEFAULT is a distinct hardcoded array used only as fallback.
No annual price is ever computed or displayed anywhere in the code — only t.monthly is rendered with '/mo', and billing-toggle has no click handler.
Tiers HTML is built via .innerHTML = data.map(t => `... ${t.name} ...`).join('') — plan name is interpolated directly into innerHTML rather than set as text.
There is no element with data-testid="billing-monthly" anywhere in the markup; only billing-toggle exists on the Annual div.
No JS logic listens for clicks on billing-toggle or billing-monthly to re-render prices; toggle is static markup with no event handlers at all.
